# Software Code Review

Review the selected code in this repository.

Do not modify any files.

Check:

1. Correctness
2. Error handling
3. Security
4. Maintainability
5. Simplicity
6. Test coverage
7. API compatibility

Return the following sections:

## Summary

Brief summary of the code.

## Findings

List concrete findings.

## Risks

List potential risks.

## Missing Tests

Identify missing test scenarios.

## Recommendations

Give practical recommendations.

Keep the review concise.

Do not recommend unnecessary frameworks,
architecture, or dependencies.
